sections.title: Great Fairies
sections.note: Stand on the Triforce in front of the pool and play Zelda's Lullaby.

items.name: Great Fairy of Magic (Hyrule Castle)
items.howTo: As young Link, bomb the boulder at the end of the path signposted as a dead end on the way up to the castle, and crawl through.
items.notes: As adult Link the castle grounds become Outside Ganon's Castle, which has its own Great Fairy.

items.name: Great Fairy of Power (Death Mountain Summit)
items.howTo: Climb to the summit of Death Mountain Trail, sheltering under the Hylian Shield from falling rocks, and bomb the cracked wall near the top.
items.notes: The first magic you can get; the Lens of Truth, spells and magic arrows all need it.

items.name: Great Fairy of Magic (Zora's Fountain)
items.howTo: Swim to the small island with a lone tree behind Lord Jabu-Jabu and bomb the boulder against its wall.

items.name: Great Fairy of Magic (Desert Colossus)
items.howTo: Bomb the cracked wall between two palm trees on the right as you arrive from the Haunted Wasteland.
items.notes: Young Link can reach it with the Requiem of Spirit.

items.name: Great Fairy of Wisdom (Death Mountain Crater)
items.howTo: As adult Link, enter the crater from Darunia's room in Goron City, cross the bridge to the right and smash the boulders along the wall with the Megaton Hammer.

items.name: Great Fairy of Courage (Outside Ganon's Castle)
items.howTo: With the Golden Gauntlets from the Shadow Trial, lift the huge black pillar at the dead end of the side path, among the boulders.
items.notes: Damage taken is halved; your hearts get a white outline.
